Original salvage machine animated by sparse mineral-organic fibers near hydraulics; coal-black steel, worn ochre frame panels, oxidized copper lines, ivory bearing collars and a tiny amber core. Premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy, beautiful believable engineering, broad clean painterly light/shadow and tactile material layers, detail concentrated at functional joints. Elevated three-quarter camera looking down about 40 degrees so the round three-foot base reads clearly. Entire long clamp, raised boom and all feet fully framed with generous transparent margin, clean silhouette identifiable at 70 pixels. Solid near-opaque subject on genuine transparent alpha. No numbered attack sectors, effects, floor, cast shadow, platform, scene, lettering, labels, logo, UI, watermark or resemblance to existing game characters.
